title: Checking immersion on target opens covering the image
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $(W_i)_{i\in I}$ be a family of open subschemes of $Y$ [def-weil-open-immersion]. Suppose $f(X)\subseteq\bigcup_{i\in I}W_i$ and that for every $i\in I$ the induced morphism $f^{-1}(W_i)\to W_i$ is an immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Then $f$ is an immersion. The index set need not be finite or nonempty.
